_**Agent (gpt-5.4 2026-05-12 09:17:06Z)**_

`git push` was rejected because `origin/main` has commits your local `main` does not. Git blocks this to avoid overwriting remote history.

Safe fix:
```bash
git fetch origin
git rebase origin/main
git push origin main
```

If `rebase` reports conflicts, resolve them, then run:
```bash
git rebase --continue
git push origin main
```

Only if you intentionally want to overwrite the remote branch, use:
```bash
git push --force-with-lease origin main
```
